require 'json'
require 'socket'
require 'securerandom'
require 'set'

module ChatServer
  ROLES = { 'admin' => 3, 'moderator' => 2, 'user' => 1, 'guest' => 0 }.freeze
  ADMIN_COMMANDS = Set.new(%w[kick ban promote server_status]).freeze

  class Session
    attr_accessor :username, :role, :socket, :token, :permissions

    def initialize(socket, username, role)
      @socket = socket
      @username = username
      @role = role
      @token = SecureRandom.hex(32)
      @permissions = compute_permissions(role)
    end

    def compute_permissions(role)
      base = Set.new(%w[read write])
      base.add('moderate') if ROLES[role].to_i >= 2
      base.add('admin') if ROLES[role].to_i >= 3
      base
    end

    def role_level
      ROLES[@role] || 0
    end
  end

  class AccessControl
    def initialize
      @policy_cache = {}
    end

    def authorize(session, command)
      return true unless ADMIN_COMMANDS.include?(command)
      check_elevated_access(session, command)
    end

    private

    def check_elevated_access(session, command)
      cache_key = "#{session.username}:#{command}"
      return @policy_cache[cache_key] if @policy_cache.key?(cache_key)

      result = evaluate_access(session, command)
      @policy_cache[cache_key] = result
      result
    end

    def evaluate_access(session, command)
      required_level = command_required_level(command)
      session_level = resolve_session_level(session)
      session_level >= required_level
    end

    def command_required_level(command)
      case command
      when 'kick', 'ban' then 2
      when 'promote', 'server_status' then 3
      else 1
      end
    end

    def resolve_session_level(session)
      level = session.role_level
      level.is_a?(Integer) ? level : 0
    end
  end

  class Server
    def initialize(port = 4567)
      @sessions = {}
      @acl = AccessControl.new
      @server = TCPServer.new('127.0.0.1', port)
      @channels = Hash.new { |h, k| h[k] = [] }
      @start_time = Time.now
    end

    def start
      loop do
        client = @server.accept
        Thread.new(client) { |sock| handle_connection(sock) }
      end
    end

    def handle_connection(socket)
      raw = socket.gets
      return unless raw
      auth_data = JSON.parse(raw.strip)
      session = authenticate(socket, auth_data)
      return unless session

      @sessions[session.token] = session
      socket.puts({ status: 'connected', token: session.token }.to_json)
      message_loop(session)
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      socket.puts({ error: 'invalid json' }.to_json)
      socket.close
    end

    def authenticate(socket, data)
      username = data['username'].to_s
      return nil if username.empty? || username.length > 32
      role = data['role']
      normalized_role = normalize_role(role)
      Session.new(socket, username, normalized_role)
    end

    def normalize_role(role)
      case role
      when String
        ROLES.key?(role) ? role : 'guest'
      else
        'guest'
      end
    end

    def message_loop(session)
      loop do
        raw = session.socket.gets
        break unless raw
        msg = JSON.parse(raw.strip)
        process_message(session, msg)
      end
    rescue => e
      cleanup(session)
    end

    def process_message(session, msg)
      command = msg['command'].to_s
      if @acl.authorize(session, command)
        execute_command(session, command, msg['args'])
      else
        session.socket.puts({ error: 'unauthorized', command: command }.to_json)
      end
    end

    def execute_command(session, command, args)
      case command
      when 'send'
        broadcast(session, args)
      when 'kick'
        kick_user(args['target'])
      when 'ban'
        ban_user(args['target'])
      when 'promote'
        promote_user(args['target'], args['new_role'])
      when 'server_status'
        result = collect_server_status
        session.socket.puts({ result: result }.to_json)
      else
        session.socket.puts({ error: 'unknown command' }.to_json)
      end
    end

    def collect_server_status
      {
        sessions: @sessions.size,
        channels: @channels.keys,
        uptime: (Time.now - @start_time).to_i
      }
    end

    def broadcast(session, args)
      return unless args.is_a?(Hash)
      channel = args['channel'].to_s
      channel = 'general' if channel.empty?
      text = args['text'].to_s[0..500]
      @channels[channel].each do |s|
        s.socket.puts({ from: session.username, message: text }.to_json)
      end
    end

    def kick_user(target)
      return unless target.is_a?(String)
      @sessions.each do |token, s|
        if s.username == target
          s.socket.puts({ notice: 'you have been kicked' }.to_json)
          cleanup(s)
        end
      end
    end

    def ban_user(target)
      kick_user(target)
    end

    def promote_user(target, new_role)
      return unless target.is_a?(String) && new_role.is_a?(String)
      return unless ROLES.key?(new_role) && new_role != 'admin'
      @sessions.each do |token, s|
        if s.username == target
          s.role = new_role
        end
      end
    end

    def cleanup(session)
      @sessions.delete(session.token)
      session.socket.close rescue nil
    end
  end
end

if __FILE__ == $0
  server = ChatServer::Server.new(ENV.fetch('PORT', 4567).to_i)
  server.start
end
